current_content_summary: Purely a set of SMT-bound primitives for int, not meant to be used directly (Int.ec is the user-facing theory built on top of it): zero, one, lt, le (derived from lt), add, opp, mul, absz (derived from le), plus the intind induction axiom. Everything here is re-exposed with friendlier infix names (<, <=, +, -[unary], *, |_|) by Int.ec.
